Kill the four horsemen.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill the four horsemen; [[Madruk Dhuum]], [[Thul Za Dhuum]], [[Ghozer Dhuum]], [[Kazhad Dhuum]] in [[the Underworld]].
* *BONUS* Kill the four horsemen in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 2,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 60 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[The Four Horsemen#Walkthrough|The Four Horsemen]] quest.
